top_signals.summary: A new tax rate of 10 per cent capital gains on up to £10m lifetime gains is designed to encourage and reward founders, but the draft rules are so narrowly drawn that hardly anyone will qualify, says John Manis In the film My Fair Lady, the heroine’s father, Alfred P Doolittle, makes a memorable case [...]

Employees in partner’s clothing? HMRC in ‘aggressive pursuit’ of LLPs
top_signals.summary: HMRC is actively writing to limited liability partnerships (LLPs) as firms race to reassess their members’ tax status after the landmark legal ruling, even as both sides “hold their cards close to their chests.” Members of an LLP are treated as self-employed partners, meaning they don’t pay the 15 per cent employer’s national insurance contributions [...]
